## Checklist

- [ ] Tests pass (`python -m pytest -q`)
- [ ] Code compiles (`python -m compileall -q app tests`)
- [ ] No secrets, API keys, or credentials are included
- [ ] No real portfolio data, account identifiers, or database files are committed
- [ ] README is updated if behavior changed
- [ ] Monitoring remains read-only (no order-placement code)
- [ ] Security implications are considered and documented
